title: Results
intro: How published posts do in search: the last 28 days against the 28 before.
notConfigured: Connect Search Console or Bing Webmaster
notConfiguredBody: The data comes from there: clicks, impressions and position for each post.
emptyBody: Press “Refresh” to fetch it. It only reads Ghost and the search engine: nothing is changed.
noPosts: No posts with data in this period.
panelEmpty: The panel hasn't changed any published post yet.
panelEmptyBody: Once you publish in Ghost a post applied from here (or change its title or meta description from Ideas), it shows up in this view.

unpublished.one: 1 post applied from the panel is still a draft: it shows up once you publish it.
unpublished.other: {count} posts applied from the panel are still drafts: they show up once you publish them.

lag: Search engines take 2-3 days to report, and Bing groups its data by week.
queriesGoogleOnly: Each post's queries are only available with Search Console.

post.noQueries: No notable queries in this period.
post.changes: Dashed line: when the panel changed it ({dates}).
post.notFound: No results for that post: press “Refresh” in Results.

impact.title: Did the panel's changes work?
impact.intro: Clicks of each post the panel changed: up to {weeks} weeks before its latest change against the same weeks after (leaving out the week of the change).
impact.none: No change can be measured yet: it takes at least 2 full weeks before and after.

pending.one: 1 post changed too recently: measured once 2 weeks have passed.
pending.other: {count} posts changed too recently: measured once 2 weeks have passed.

tooOld.one: 1 post changed before the 16 weeks with data: nothing to compare.
tooOld.other: {count} posts changed before the 16 weeks with data: nothing to compare.

impact.caveat: Indicative: “against expected” discounts how the rest of the blog moved over the same weeks (season, Google updates), but it isn't an experiment.
impact.postLine: Changed {date}. In the {weeks} weeks after it had {after} clicks against {before} in the {weeks} before ({change}). Rest of the blog: {blog}. Against expected: {lift}.
impact.post_pending: The latest change is too recent: it can be measured once 2 full weeks have passed.
impact.post_tooOld: The latest change is older than the weeks with data: nothing to compare.
impact.fewNote: “Too little data”: fewer than {min} clicks before and after together; with so few, a percentage means nothing.
impact.postFew: Changed {date}: {before} clicks in the {weeks} weeks before and {after} in the {weeks} after. That's fewer than {min}: too few to draw conclusions.
